figures.title: Chapter map
figures.why: the chapter is three instruments (tube, crystal, photon) and one particle
figures.read: every result is production, the element fingerprint, geometry, or the photon's momentum hook

figures.title: One tube voltage, one cutoff
figures.why: the voltage gene lambda_min separates production intuition from absorption intuition
figures.read: the short-wavelength edge depends only on voltage, never on target or current

figures.title: Compton kinematics in one line
figures.why: the shift formula is pure relativistic billiards; energy and momentum books run in parallel
figures.data: photon p=h/lambda strikes electron at rest; scattered photon at theta, electron at phi
figures.read: energy and momentum close the triangle; the shift depends only on angle

figures.title: The Compton shift versus angle
figures.why: the same shift is invisible for visible light and huge for hard X-rays
figures.read: the shift runs 0 to 4.86 pm and is the same for every target

figures.title: Triage - match the keyword to the law
figures.why: the keyword names the equation before any number is touched
figures.read: voltage to cutoff, angle to Bragg, scattered wavelength to Compton

figures.title: Moseley: the element fingerprint is a straight line
figures.why: the same screened-nucleus formula places every element; sqrt(f) vs Z is how Moseley counted them
figures.read: each element's K line is a booked position on one straight line
